#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Collect log files into a dated archive
set -euo pipefail
label='inventory'
root="${1:-./logs}"
limit=20
archive="${label}-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
function collect() {
  local count=0
  for file in "$root"/*.log; do
    if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
      printf '%s\\n' "$file"
      ((count += 1))
    fi
    [[ "$count" -ge "$limit" ]] && break
  done
}
collect | sort > files.txt
if grep -q 'error' files.txt; then
  echo "Review the selected files"
else
  tar -czf "$archive" -T files.txt
fi

module Inventory
  class Catalog
    LIMIT = 0x20
    def initialize(label = "inventory")
      @label = label
      @enabled = true
    end
    def total(prices)
      sum = 1.5e2
      prices.each do |price|
        if price > 0
          sum += price
        end
      end
      return @enabled ? sum : nil
    end
    def describe
      "#{@label}\\n"
    end
  end
end

! Array-based inventory total
module inventory
  implicit none
contains
  function total(prices) result(value)
    real, intent(in) :: prices(:)
    real :: value
    integer :: i
    value = 0.0
    do i = 1, size(prices)
      if (prices(i) > 0.0) value = value + prices(i)
    end do
  end function total
end module inventory
program report

  print *, "Inventory total", total([12.5, 18.0, 42.0])
end program report

    Active = Table.SelectRows(Typed, each [Active] = true),
    Positive = Table.SelectRows(Active, each [Price] > 0),
    Discounted = Table.AddColumn(Positive, "Net", each [Price] * 0.9),
    Sorted = Table.Sort(Discounted, {{"Product", Order.Ascending}}),
    Total = List.Sum(Sorted[Net]),
    Report = [Name = "Inventory", Count = Table.RowCount(Sorted), Total = Total]
in
    Report

total <- function(records, limit = 32L) {

  if (nrow(selected) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(selected$price, na.rm = TRUE)
}

module Inventory
  class Catalog
    LIMIT = 0x20
    def initialize(label = 'inventory')
      @label = label
      @enabled = true
    end
    def total(prices)
      sum = 1.5e2
      prices.each do |price|
        if price > 0
          sum += price
        end
      end
      return @enabled ? sum : nil
    end
    def describe
      "#{@label}\\n"
    end
  end
end
